title: Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery: Time Limits Counted from the Initial Debt Notice
content:
Every debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** starts its clocks on the date of the initial notice of rights and obligations. The periods below are calendar days counted from that notice date, and they are the same for the debt types shown unless the row says otherwise.

| Debt type | Waiver request window (calendar days) | Collection-hold window (calendar days) | Benefit withholding begins after (calendar days) | Second demand letter sent after (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Education Overpayment (Chapters 30, 35 and 1606) | 180 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment | 180 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment | 180 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Disability Compensation Overpayment | 180 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Veterans Pension Overpayment | 180 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Home Loan Guaranty Debt | 365 | 30 | 30 | 30 |

| Debt type | Committee decision goal for a complete waiver request (calendar days) | Regional office dispute review goal (calendar days) | Initial notice of rights and obligations required before any collection |
|---|---|---|---|
| Education Overpayment (Chapters 30, 35 and 1606) | 120 | 30 | Yes |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment | 120 | 30 | Yes |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment | 120 | 30 | Yes |
| Disability Compensation Overpayment | 120 | 30 | Yes |
| Veterans Pension Overpayment | 120 | 30 | Yes |
| Home Loan Guaranty Debt | 120 | 30 | Yes |

## What each period means

- **Waiver request window** — the days after the initial debt notice within which a waiver request must be received to be considered.
- **Collection-hold window** — the days after the initial debt notice within which a waiver request or dispute stops collection until it is decided.
- **Benefit withholding begins after** — the days after the initial debt notice before VA begins withholding from benefit payments.
- **Second demand letter** — the day after the initial notice on which the second demand letter is sent when no response is received.
- **Decision and review goals** — the target days for the Committee on Waivers and Compromises to decide a complete waiver request, and for the regional office to complete a dispute review. They are targets, not deadlines that change the outcome.
- **Initial notice required** — for every debt type the initial notice of rights and obligations must be sent before any collection.

## Reading the schedule

**Which debt type has a longer waiver window?** A Home Loan Guaranty Debt: 365 calendar days, against 180 calendar days for each of the other five debt types.

**Do the hold window and the waiver window end together?** No. For every debt type the collection-hold window is 30 calendar days, while the waiver window is 180 or 365 calendar days; a waiver request can therefore be timely without falling inside the hold window.

**Hypothetical illustration.** For a Disability Compensation Overpayment whose notice is dated on some Day 0, the collection-hold window runs through Day 30 and the waiver request window through Day 180; for a Home Loan Guaranty Debt with the same notice date, the waiver request window runs through Day 365.
